options.text: A transformation that increases carbon bonding to oxygen or decreases carbon bonding to hydrogen.

options.label: B
options.text: Removal of the elements of water from an alcohol to form an alkene under suitable conditions.

options.label: C
options.text: An alcohol whose hydroxyl-bearing carbon is attached to two carbon groups.

options.label: D
options.text: An alcohol whose hydroxyl-bearing carbon is attached to three carbon groups.

questions.correct_answer: An alcohol whose hydroxyl-bearing carbon is attached to two carbon groups.
questions.explanation: The distinguishing description for secondary alcohol is: An alcohol whose hydroxyl-bearing carbon is attached to two carbon groups.

questions.question: You need to distinguish “alcohol” from several related chapter concepts. Which description uniquely identifies it?

options.label: A
options.text: The resonance-stabilized conjugate base formed by deprotonating a phenol.

options.label: B
options.text: Replacement of the hydroxyl-derived group at carbon by another atom or group after appropriate activation.

options.label: C
options.text: An alcohol whose hydroxyl-bearing carbon is attached to one other carbon group.

options.label: D
options.text: A compound containing a hydroxyl group bonded to an sp3-hybridized carbon.

questions.correct_answer: A compound containing a hydroxyl group bonded to an sp3-hybridized carbon.
questions.explanation: The distinguishing description for alcohol is: A compound containing a hydroxyl group bonded to an sp3-hybridized carbon.

questions.question: You need to distinguish “oxidation of alcohol” from several related chapter concepts. Which description uniquely identifies it?

options.label: A
options.text: A compound in which a hydroxyl group is bonded directly to an aromatic ring.

options.label: B
options.text: An alcohol whose hydroxyl-bearing carbon is attached to one other carbon group.

options.label: C
options.text: Replacement of the hydroxyl-derived group at carbon by another atom or group after appropriate activation.

options.label: D
options.text: A transformation that increases carbon bonding to oxygen or decreases carbon bonding to hydrogen.

questions.correct_answer: A transformation that increases carbon bonding to oxygen or decreases carbon bonding to hydrogen.
questions.explanation: The distinguishing description for oxidation of alcohol is: A transformation that increases carbon bonding to oxygen or decreases carbon bonding to hydrogen.
